scenes: Can protecting people from heat be a business?
Here are thirty-two ideas, | at least one for every one of the twenty-one vicious cycles.
The strongest ideas sell protection that is looked after over time, | not just a product.
They are ideas to explore and test, not proven models.
Who could pay, who it helps, what needs to be in place.
